patches.name: Endless Fall & 3-Lives
patches.description: Replaces instant fall-death with continuous falling onto previous platforms with live score reduction, adds a 3-lives HUD system with balanced fall damage and monster/UFO damage with brief invulnerability, and tracks Peak Score. Black Holes remain instant Game Over.

patches.name: Foldable Seamless Wide View
patches.description: Zooms out wide/unfolded screens (such as Galaxy Z Fold / 4:3 tablets) to full tall portrait vertical visibility (~600 logical height), centers UI cleanly without 4:3 overlap, remaps touch input, and fills the side margins with seamless cylindrical wrap-around rendering of the playfield.
